messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your account is having some technical problems.', 'Your booking is confirmed.', "We're rebooting our SSL server due to recent upgrade on our security to serve you better.", 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'the profile that you are using to access Abbey Financial Group Online Banking has been locked because of too many failed login attempts.', 'We re-writing to let you know that your online account has been temporarily suspended due to recent access to your account from an unknown IP address.', 'Email Notification: Your Account As Been Debited', "This message is to alert you that you have a new response from customer care in your secure messages' area of your Internet Banking.", 'You have one new security message from ANZ Internet Banking', 'We detect irregular activity on your Halifax Internet banking account on 11/10/2010.', "We'll send you a pack through the post which explains this in more detail.", 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'Security machines at Halifax have been upgraded to provide customers with a faster, easier and more efficient online banking experience.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'Your Account is Suspended, Some information on your account appears to be missing or incorrect.', 'Your eBay account is temporarily locked - Confirm your identity', 'Your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade to our database', 'PetroSun Announces Formation of Algae BioFuels', 'Thanks for your order, arnold@highwayman.com', 'You have received this email because you or someone had used your account from different locations.', 'Your ad, titled "SONY PlayStation 3 METAL GEAR SOLID 4 PS3 80 GB BUNDLE!", has been posted as follows:<<link>> (electronics)', 'We are contacting you to remind you that on August 03, 2010, the Chase Security Department identified some unusual activity involving your Chase Card account.', 'You have received this email because we have strong reason to believe that your PayPal account had been recently compromised.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
